itens.descricao: The Bet Alphabet Holders Made Yahoo Finance
trechos: For Alphabet shareholders, the return over the past year was 23.5%, including dividends.
Back on 23 October 2025, analysts were already arguing over how far AI powered cloud services and infrastructure spending might reshape Alphabet's earnings mix.
Pinpoint other ways to investigate the theme among 55 AI infrastructure stocks.
It suggested a Fair Value of US$291, the price implied if assumptions played out, based on 13.8% revenue growth and a future P/E of 26.8x.
The more cautious narrative still saw AI adoption helping the business but put Fair Value at US$234.
This view was anchored to 11.4% revenue growth and concern that record capital expenditure near US$85b might pressure margins if growth slowed.

What The Alphabet Evidence Put To The Test The biggest new fact was Alphabet's AI driven cloud surge, with Q2 2026 revenue at US$119.8b versus US$96.4b a year earlier and net income at US$112.1b versus US$28.2b.

That jump in profit and a net margin rising from 29.2% to 93.6% supported the more positive thesis on earnings power, while record AI capex and dilution concerns still reflected a cautious view on potential cash strain.

Tesla And SpaceX Explore Combination; EV Giant's Q3 Earnings Drop Elon Musk said Tuesday that Tesla and his rocket manufacturing company SpaceX have each formed special committees of independent directors to evaluate a potential merger.
On SpaceX's quarterly earnings call, he described combining the companies as "a good idea" but said he has recused himself from the discussions because of conflicts of interest.

Both revenue and earnings, however, dropped from the corresponding quarter of 2025.
Automotive revenue declined 3%, while energy generation and storage revenue fell 16%.
Operating margin compressed amid continued heavy investment in AI, robotics, and autonomy, raising capital expenditure by 110% to $4.7 billion.

itens.titulo: Bitcoin Usually Bottoms After Midterm Elections. What Happens if This Cycle Breaks the Pattern?
itens.descricao: Bitcoin Usually Bottoms After Midterm Elections. What Happens if This Cycle Breaks the Pattern? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - Bitcoin bottomed 13 to 71 days after each of the past three midterms but in 2026 hit its low 125 days before the election.
- Spot Bitcoin ETFs now hold $105 billion in net assets, enabling daily Wall Street inflows that may have shifted the bottom earlier.
- Bitcoin must hold $57,718 to confirm an early cycle bottom; a drop below $60,000 before January 2027 would revive the traditional post-midterm timing.
- It sounds nuts, but SoFi is giving new Active Invest users up to $1,000 in stock for a limited time, and all it takes is a $50 deposit to get started.
Each time, the Bitcoin midterm bottom arrived between 13 and 71 days after voters cast their ballots.
This time, however, Bitcoin broke that pattern early, hitting a low of $57,718 on July 1, well ahead of the November 3 midterms and 125 days before the election.
Bitcoin is currently trading around $81,234, about 40% higher than its July low, even after a 2.8% decline in October.

Longtime Bitcoin advocate Michael Saylor expressed on X (formerly Twitter) on October 13, "I think we hit the bottom slightly below $60,000." This raises the question: did the usual post-midterm recovery start months early, or is another drop still ahead?

itens.titulo: Ibovespa reage antes das eleições; Petrobras (PETR4) sobe 1,47% e Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) dispara
itens.descricao: Ibovespa reage antes das eleições; Petrobras (PETR4) sobe 1,47% e Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) dispara Suno - Investimentos Inteligentes
trechos: Negócios Ibovespa reage antes das eleições; Petrobras (PETR4) sobe 1,47% e Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) dispara O Ibovespa deixou para a última hora uma recuperação antes do segundo turno das eleições presidenciais.
Nesta sexta-feira (23), o principal índice da B3 avançou 0,47%, aos 205.082,56 pontos, um ganho de 962,44 pontos, após passar boa parte do pregão no vermelho.
A reação, porém, não foi suficiente para salvar a semana, encerrada com queda de 0,17%.

A valorização foi sustentada por ações de peso, como Petrobras (PETR4), Vale (VALE3) e Banco do Brasil (BBAS3), em um pregão marcado pela expectativa em torno da disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro.
Com a votação marcada para domingo (25), os investidores ajustaram suas posições diante das pesquisas mais recentes, mas sem uma definição clara sobre o resultado.
O IPCA-15 de outubro veio abaixo das expectativas, contribuindo para a queda dos juros futuros e oferecendo algum alívio às empresas mais sensíveis às taxas.
Maiores altas e baixas A Petrobras (PETR4) subiu 1,47%, acompanhando a valorização do petróleo internacional.
Vale (VALE3) avançou 0,67%, interrompendo três pregões consecutivos de perdas, favorecida pela recuperação do minério de ferro.

itens.titulo: Post-it Notes maker 3M eyes AI gold rush in major Amazon deal
itens.descricao: Post-it Notes maker 3M eyes AI gold rush in major Amazon deal Yahoo Finance Singapore
trechos: 3M (MMM) is a company that is famous for Post-it Notes, Scotch tape, and the N95 respirators many of us became familiar with during the pandemic.
Recently, 3M expanded its commercial deal with Amazon, and it's worth up to $6 billion in future purchases of fiber-optic gear for Amazon's cloud and AI data centers.
In the days after the news broke, MMM shares increased by more than 5%.
Inside the expanded Amazon partnership for 3M On Oct.
19, 3M signed the expanded deal with an Amazon subsidiary, according to an SEC filing.
As part of the agreement, the company gave Amazon a warrant to buy up to 3.16 million 3M shares over the next seven years at $164.89 each.

Also read: OpenAI CFO offers calming message amid AI slowdown fears However, about 85% of those shares will only unlock if Amazon ends up buying up to $6 billion of 3M's optical connectivity and data center products during that window, Reuters reported.
The remaining 15% will be unlocked as certain milestone conditions are met.
